author: martbln
name: Differential Transformer 7x512 SP-1024
blurb: Replaces standard GQA with Differential Attention (Ye et al. 2024): two Q/K streams share one V, output is SDPA(Q1,K1,V) - lambda*SDPA(Q2,K2,V). Per-head learnable lambda via sigmoid. SubLN applied head-wise before output projection. num_layers reduced 9->7 to offset the extra Q/K params, net ~16.1M params. Results pending training run.
